---
title: "Sprott S System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -x+ay\\
\dot{y} &=& x+z^2\\
\dot{z} &=& 1+x
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-5$ and initial condition $(-1,0,-1)$.
